_comment: TOOL: public code and generic documentation.
FIXTURE: synthetic examples generated only by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA: all real transcripts, judge prompts, responses, results and observations live in the versioned PRIVATE companion, never in the public tool tree.

The shared resolver discovers storage; evaluation_store.py runs no runtime PRIVATE proof. Before reads and atomic writes it checks only paths: a separate versioned companion outside the tool tree, containment in the data directory, no Git metadata, nested repository or filesystem alias. Commit-time guards keep the companion out of public remotes.

CONFIG.md defines a config root: profile.json, registry.json, data/ and people/<id>/. Real roots live only in the PRIVATE companion. The data entries under skills/shopping-aggregator/config/ sit beside their generated examples, which is where a copied real file would land; data_sealed lists the config-root names that must never appear at this repository's root.
_data_home: A config root (CONFIG.md) in the verified PRIVATE companion, resolved by the fleet_guards companion resolver or selected with SHOPPING_AGGREGATOR_CONFIG / --config-dir; run DATA goes to <root>/data: metrics/live-runs.jsonl.d/ and purchases.jsonl.d/ (one <CLAUDE_MACHINE_ID>.jsonl lane per machine, for example node-a.jsonl), evaluation/runs/<run-id>/ and cache/
